subject: BrightBank SIG: request for IR playbook and retention details
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Janet Johnson <janet.johnson@brightbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBank SIG: request for IR playbook and retention details

Hi Janet —

Following up on BrightBank's SIG/CAIQ review, the security team asked for a short IR compatibility check so you can confirm we meet your onboarding requirements. Can you confirm availability to accept the following items and an estimated window for ingestion?

Quick asks (we aim to keep this light):
- Redwood incident response playbook (summary, not full logs) — what format do you prefer (PDF/Drive link)?
- Retention policy for auth/telemetry logs (S3 retention windows and sampling policy)
- Contact for escalation and preferred SSO/MFA confirmation
- Any redaction or artifact-handling constraints required by BrightBank legal

If you prefer, we can share a redacted IR summary and a compressed artifact bundle for your team to ingest.

Planned attachments:
- redwood_irp_summary.pdf (high level IRP, controls & contact points)

Proposed next step: 30-min sync today or tomorrow for handoff and to discuss any scope limits.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Janet Johnson <janet.johnson@brightbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightbank.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 13:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BrightBank SIG: request for IR playbook and retention details

Karthik —

Thanks for the note. Heads-up: this morning our SOC detected anomalous API activity tied to a small set of client tokens. We're investigating; at this point it looks contained to a test tenant but we need to run through a quick evidence collection and timeline.

Immediate asks from BrightBank:
1) Please provide the IRP summary and a point of contact for incident escalation (name + phone).
2) Confirm retention windows for API auth logs and any available request traces we can pull for 2027-05-09 through 2027-05-11 (UTC).
3) If possible, please share any sanitized request traces or block-level telemetry for the affected tenant (we understand redaction rules).

I've attached a short summary from our SOC (brightbank_incident_summary.pdf) so you have current context. We can coordinate a call at 16:00 EDT today if that works for your team.

--
Janet Johnson
Head of Security Operations
BrightBank

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Janet Johnson <janet.johnson@brightbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security@brightbank.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBank SIG: request for IR playbook and retention details

Janet —

Appreciate the flag and the summary. We're treating this as high priority. Immediate responses below and attached the playbook summary as requested.

What we are sending now:
- redwood_irp_summary.pdf (attached) — includes primary escalation contact and phone number (Karthik Iyer, +1 (415) 555-0199).
- Statement of retention: auth logs retained 90 days in hot storage; telemetry traces 180 days archived (with sampling; full-request traces stored for 14 days).
- Available traces: we can export sanitized request traces for 2027-05-09 -> 2027-05-11 UTC. We'll redact user identifiers per your spec; include request IDs and timestamps.

Immediate containment actions (already executed):
- Rotated affected client tokens and issued new credentials to the tenant admin.
- Scoped traffic rules to block the anomalous IP ranges at the edge for the tenant.
- Captured and preserved request traces and agent telemetry in an evidence bucket (see Drive link).

Next steps:
- We can join your 16:00 EDT call (confirming Marissa and I will be on).
- We'll prepare a sanitized artifact bundle and a preliminary timeline for the call; full postmortem within 72 hours.

Forwarded-For-Record:
On Tue, 11 May 2027 at 13:47, Janet Johnson <janet.johnson@brightbank.com> wrote:
> Karthik —
> 
> Thanks for the note. Heads-up: this morning our SOC detected anomalous API activity tied to a small set of client tokens. ...

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Janet Johnson <janet.johnson@brightbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, security@brightbank.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBank SIG: request for IR playbook and retention details — post-incident follow-up

Janet / BrightBank team —

Follow-up with the artifacts we committed to during yesterday's call. Attached is the full post-incident packet and remediation summary. Highlights:

- Root cause: expired vault key on a third-party CI runner caused a fallback that replayed stale tokens; this allowed limited test-tenant access. No customer data exfiltration detected.
- Actions taken: key rotation, hardened CI secrets handling, additional SSO MFA enforcement, alerting rule adjustments to detect replay patterns.
- Evidence included: redwood_postmortem_brightbank_20270511.pdf (full timeline and remediation), sanitized request traces (in Drive link), and a summary of control changes.

Attachments:
- redwood_postmortem_brightbank_20270511.pdf (PDF)
- redwood_irp_summary.pdf (PDF, repeated for ease)

Retention & next steps:
- We'll retain the raw traces for 90 days for BrightBank's audit window and can provide additional exports if your compliance team needs them for SIG/SOC2 mapping.
- If you prefer a redacted SOC2 evidence bundle crosswalk (SIG->SOC2 controls), we can prepare that as a separate deliverable.

If there are any outstanding redaction rules or legal constraints for evidence transfer, please flag them and we'll start a segmented export.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
